facts.fact: internal/llmprompts holds every LLM prompt and LLM-facing instruction both apps (Space and Studio) send.
internal/llmprompts not internal/prompts, which is P246 popup router.
registry.go only file containing prompt text.
Registry entry has: id, kind, apps, title/purpose/usedBy catalog keys, applies-when, default, required fragments, fixed output schema.
Registry entries accessed through typed handle Prompt[V] with Text(src, vars).
Registry entries without variables use NoVars.
Registry entry kinds: system, message, suffix, instructions, tool, argument, toolResult, fragment.
Kind argument: one MCP tool property description; carries Parent tool and Field.
Kind fragment included via {{template}}.
Prompt registry excludes user-authored text: smart-script bodies, workflow stage prompts, step prompts.
Prompt registry also excludes tool and server names, tool error strings, result data formatting.
InputSchema[T] sets each MCP tool property's description from its argument registry entry.
Mismatch between tool property and its argument entry panics at server build.
jsonschema tags not used.
Prompt templates use text/template, one template set per resolve, only funcs inc and join.
Entry with NoVars and no fragments is literal, never parsed.
Default prompt renders byte-identical to pre-P271 output (testdata/golden).
RenderParts wraps each string variable in marker runes and splits, so Settings Preview marks resolved values with VarText.
Failed RenderParts self-check returns one literal part.
Prompt overrides stored per app in <home>/llm-prompts.json (~/.kira-studio/, ~/.kira-space/).
llm-prompts.json written with renameio, mode 0600.
llm-prompts.json shape: {version, revision, overrides: {id: {text, defaultHash, updatedAt}}}.
Saving default text removes prompt override.
Prompt override text must be 1 byte to 32 KiB.
Prompt change carries baseHash; stale change refused with E_CONFLICT.
If prompt store file corrupt or override no longer validates, default used and warning logged.
Settings flags corrupt store or invalid override with storeError and invalid.
defaultChanged flags override made against older default.
Server-side override validation requires template parses and executes against example vars.
Server-side override validation requires every prompt:"required" variable referenced and every required fragment included.
Memory system prompts must include fragment memory.dataHygiene, the injection defence.
Schema-bound prompts (gate, reconcile, import extract and finalize) keep JSON schema fixed, shown read-only in Settings.
No global prompt source.
Consumers receive llmprompts.Source (Resolve, Revision) through options.
Consumers of llmprompts.Source: memory.ServiceOptions, mcpserver.Options, claudeheadless, scriptruns, ADE, dbmcp.
Defaults() is registry-only source.
Store.Resolve stats file per call, re-reads on mtime or size change.
Gate, reconcile, import, headless suffixes and ADE messages resolve per call, so prompt edit applies on next call.
memory-mcp is stdio subprocess; memorycli.Run gets <KiraSpaceHome>/llm-prompts.json.
memory-mcp builds server instructions, tool and argument descriptions once per process, so edits apply to new Claude sessions.
dbmcp and claudeheadless rebuild MCP server when Revision() changes.
Prompt IPC: LlmPromptsService (List, Save, Preview) in both apps, plus event kira:llmPrompts:changed {revision}.
Save all-or-nothing; per-id errors returned as E_BAD_REQUEST payload.
Preview with real vars also renders ADE run dialog and step inspector, so no TS copy of a prompt exists.
Settings section Prompts sits before Advanced in both apps, in packages/workbench/src/llmPrompts/.
Prompts section: list, Monaco editor, Changes diff against default, Preview, per-entry reset.
Drafts live in Pinia store llmPromptDrafts.
Dialog Save saves prompts first, then settings patch.
Guard go run ./internal/llmprompts/cmd/checkprompts part of bun run lint.
checkprompts fails on jsonschema tag.
checkprompts fails on mcp.Tool, mcp.Prompt or mcp.PromptArgument Description, or mcp.ServerOptions Instructions, not from llmprompts.
checkprompts fails on memory.Call System not from llmprompts.
checkprompts fails on copy of registry default in non-test .go, .ts or .vue file outside internal/llmprompts and internal/flowtest.
Copy detection matches first 48 characters of registry default, or whole text when 24 to 47 characters.
